specification_source: User confirmed 3S lithium battery, 1650 mAh, nominal 11.1 V, charge limit 12.6 V
curve_scope: Generic resting-voltage LiPo reference, not calibrated to this battery; the reference's 0-2 percent endpoint is displayed as 0 percent
estimate_note: Approximate voltage-based estimate using F407 ADC; load, temperature, cell balance, aging and ADC error affect it. More useful after resting. Capacity is nominal only; no coulomb counting. UI charging hint only, not a discharge cutoff or charging controller.
